hero.description: I design user-friendly digital experiences that blend creativity and technology.
about.title: About.
about.greeting: Hi, I'm Haitem Laouaoudja, a 2CP student at ESI Algiers and a dedicated web developer from Taher, Jijel, Algeria. I'm deeply passionate about creating digital experiences that merge creativity with logic, transforming ideas into impactful and purposeful web solutions.
about.p1: At ESI, I've built a solid foundation in computer science, from algorithms to software design. My true passion lies in front-end development crafting interactive and elegant web experiences. I create clean, functional websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js, turning ideas into intuitive and enjoyable interfaces.
about.p2: I've developed several projects that showcase my technical growth and design sense, including a To-Do List app for organization and a Mawaqit website displaying prayer times with a smooth, minimal interface. These projects strengthened my skills in modern web practices, dynamic data handling, and user experience design. Beyond coding, I value teamwork believing that great products come from empathy, communication, and shared vision.
about.p3: My goal is to become a full-stack developer able to manage every layer of a web application, from database logic to user interface. I'm enhancing my React expertise, exploring Node.js and backend development, and deepening my understanding of UI/UX design to build seamless digital experiences. For me, web development is more than coding it's about blending creativity, logic, and purpose to make life simpler and more connected.
work.title: Work.
work.description: Here are some of the projects I've worked on, reflecting my growth as a developer and my passion for creating clean, user-focused web applications. Each project helped me strengthen my technical skills and explore new tools and design approaches.
project.todo.title: To Do List
project.todo.details: A simple and elegant productivity website that helps users manage their daily tasks. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js, it allows users to add, edit, and remove tasks while keeping them saved using localStorage. I focused on creating a clean interface and smooth user experience that makes staying organized effortless.
project.mawaquit.title: Mawaquit
project.mawaquit.details: A modern website that displays daily prayer times for cities across Algeria. Developed with React.js, it features a minimal layout, responsive design, and accurate data from a public API. This project helped me understand API fetching and taught me the importance of designing clear, accessible user interfaces.
project.weather.title: Weather WebSite
project.weather.details: A simple yet functional weather website that shows live temperature, humidity, and forecast data for any city. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and the OpenWeatherMap API, it updates weather details instantly as users search for a location. I built this to strengthen my understanding of APIs, real-time data handling, and user-friendly design principles.
project.portfolio.title: Portfolio Website
project.portfolio.details: My personal portfolio website designed and developed with React.js. It showcases my work, skills, and contact details in a structured and visually balanced way. This project helped me master component-based design and responsive layouts while expressing my identity as a developer.
